facts.fact: Ansira supports over 500 brands and manages $7.2 billion in marketing dollars through its platform, according to StackAdapt's press release.
facts.quote: Ansira supports over 500 brands operating across complex brand-to-local networks and manages $7.2 billion in marketing dollars through its platform.

facts.fact: Ansira's comprehensive review of the DSP landscape lasted six months before it selected StackAdapt, per Ansira's SVP of Growth and Strategic Partnerships.
facts.quote: After a comprehensive six-month review of the DSP landscape, StackAdapt stood out for its campaign performance, location-based capabilities, measurement, ease of use, and client service.

facts.fact: Ansira is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 1,300+ team members, connecting 500+ brands and over a million partners.
facts.quote: Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, the company combines AI-infused technology, closed-loop analytics, and the expertise of 1,300+ team members to connect 500+ brands and over a million partners.

facts.fact: StackAdapt will serve as a demand-side platform (DSP) for Ansira, powering programmatic media activation for its clients.
facts.quote: StackAdapt will serve as a demand-side platform (DSP) for Ansira, powering programmatic media activation on behalf of its clients
